periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, extending towards the upper-outer corner of the cranium.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elliptical morphology with a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch exhibits a pronounced downward taper, with the centroid shifted superiorly relative to the lower-most point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile at the posterior margin of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band height is approximately 30% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separated by a gap approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit a smooth, rounded convex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced rufous (brownish-red) staining on the pelage of the ventral-posterior and hind limb regions.
